name: TrainBreath
_intent: Seated cross-legged under the falls, facing the camera: one slow breath. Inhale for 2.5 s: the spine lengthens, chest and shoulders rise, chin lifts, both hands rise palms-up from the knees to chest height gathering energy; Pulse at the top; exhale in 0.5 s: hands turn over and press down to the knees.
_reference: qigong 'gathering and pressing' breath, seated; Pulse at frame 75 (2.5000 s)
